T-Dagger TGK313 Bora TKL Mechanical Gaming Keyboard (Blue Switches)

Optimize your gaming setup and maximize your desk space with the highly popular T-Dagger TGK313 Bora TKL Mechanical Gaming Keyboard. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance hardware component features a compact 87-key Tenkeyless (TKL) layout that removes the numpad to give your gaming mouse unlimited tracking freedom. It stands as the definitive choice for competitive FPS players, programmers, and budget builders across Egypt looking for an immediate hardware modification to accelerate typing speed and streamline desktop configurations.

The T-Dagger TGK313 Bora comes outfitted with premium clicky Blue Mechanical Switches, delivering a highly satisfying tactile bump and a distinct audible click sound profile that gives gamers and fast typists absolute physical feedback with every stroke. Integrated with a vibrant, dynamic Rainbow backlighting ecosystem and high-grade double-injection keycaps, it ensures long-term wear resistance. Complete with a robust, durable chassis and full n-key rollover anti-ghosting technology, it provides a highly stable, lag-free daily hardware performance environment.
